title: Good idea, but money grab execution
body: The game itself me concept is nice, something akin to a more detailed FIFA my career style sim. That’s where the positives stop though, it seems you have to spend real money to actually advance and regardless of if you do pay real money for in game currency you have to constantly watch ads to refill stats like form, stamina, or injury status. If you don’t fall for the money trap (I haven’t paid for a a single thing) then you’re stuck behind constantly. I’ve gotten lucky and won a euro cup title with Sweden but everything else you will never achieve. With whatever club you sign to you will notice a ridiculous amount of draws and losses, low pay, underperformance of your player regardless of stats or stat boosts, and the list goes on. Overall, the game is a fun idea in theory but other than that you’re just feeding these “developers” pockets. 2/10 game at least there’s no random ads that interrupt gameplay lol.

title: Game is Fun but…
body: I have played this game everyday for the last 2 weeks and its pretty fun. There are few things that I don’t like. It seems as if the simulator is created so that you have to spend real life money to become a great in the game. If you wanna buy the top tier staff and too tier equipment you would be spending around $10 million per year on just those things. Thats extremely expensive. Then the salary offers do not match your transfer valuation. I have a transfer valuation of $14 million but they are only offering me $14k Per week which comes out to about $728k, that literally makes zero sense. Another thing is, I have made it to the S league several times with different players and its the same story my performance drops dramatically from the previous year and my team does horrible and get relegated. Its like when you get to the S league you’re playing literal gods or something. And last thing that is a a bit annoying is that I miss games every year due to suspension from acquiring too many yellow cards, I don’t know why the game wants the player to be so aggressive. Even my goal keeper got suspended from receiving too many yellow cards, like thats ridiculous. Other than that game is pretty good, although, I don’t think you’ll ever win ballon d’or unless you spend actual money, to be able to pay for the top tier things. Also one update I would like to see is a cumulative tracker for defensive stats when you use a defensive player, such as saves and tackles. You only know how many tackles you have for the season if you finish top 20. And theres no cumulative tracker for saves at all which is a big part of being a goal keeper

title: Potential Man
body: Everyone’s top reviews sums it up. This game had great POTENTIAL, yes potential, but currently we aren’t playing with the potential we know it has. First of all, the entire progression of your damn player runs on ads. Skills (I have to mention, why is it that everytime I upgrade my skill, the effect goes up, but not the possibility of it too? My player has a 1000% increased heading ability with a still low possibility. He is flying at that point.) Ads. Low stamina (not to mention, the stamina system being unfair on purpose so you become reliant on ads. Like c’mon, you can watch 20 ads.)? Yeah go ahead! Click on that ad! In my opinion, they are using the gimmick of ads wrong. Your progression isn’t supposed to run on advertisements. Ads are supposed to FEEL like a little cheat for you. “Yeah, hehe I’ma watch this to get ahead of others!” NOT us being ((REQUIRED)) to watch an ad again because our player with the lung development of a baby got is running on 15% stamina after 5 matches. Do not get me wrong, this is a good game, and the POTENTIAL it has goes through the roof, if not for its over-reliance on ads and the stamina system being broken. I have played for about an hour now, so I haven’t got to see everything that this game offers, but its reliance on ads is already getting to me. I get it, you need money, but players will naturally watch ads if you set it up as the way I mentioned, not being consistently forced to watch it so the game can function, and it can be said that it is 30% ads, 70% gameplay. I wrote this long and managed to keep my attention writing it because I wanna enjoy this game, not to hate. I hope this helps.

title: Great game, even greater potential
body: This game does a very good job of simulation and stat building, but the only issue is around age 25 or 105-110 OVR your stats drastically begin to slow down, even with the new talents and the genius one which increases the rate of your progression, you can never reach the level of the top club players. Its even worse that some of the talents are locked behind limited time events which feels very lame. As a result of this, being scouted by a top club is essentially impossible, by the time you make it to a first division team that isn't being relegated every season, your stats are already beginning to deteriorate due to age. I understand this is a mobile game and microtransactions are a big part of the model, but making it essentially impossible to reach the top while the other opponents are 150 rated at 16-20 is not very good balance. I think this can easily be fixed by either- 1. Increasing the rate at which your stats increase 2. Adding better talents to give you higher ratings at a younger age 3. Nerfing the opponents Ideally 1 would be best, 2 is a band aid fix and 3 is a fine choice.

title: Lot of Potential
body: Hey, personally I think this game is already great, but it has a lot more potential. I really like how hard it is to get transfers to top clubs in the top 5 leagues—it makes progression feel earned. However, it feels too restrictive at times. Even when my player is rated higher than top players like Mbappé, Vini Jr., or Messi, big clubs still don’t show interest, and only lower-table or relegation teams do. Also, when staying at a club for 1–3 seasons and earning promotion, getting relegated immediately the next season feels unrealistic and frustrating. On top of that, scoring feels unbalanced—being 119 rated but only scoring 5–10 goals in an entire season doesn’t make sense statistically. Overall, transfers and scoring seem overly difficult regardless of stats, and adjusting these systems would make the game feel more realistic and rewarding.

title: Great Game, Tons of Potential
body: I really enjoy this game — it’s fun, immersive, and has a lot of promise. That said, I do have a few suggestions that could take it to the next level: • Player Archetypes: It would be amazing to have the option to choose what kind of player you want to be — like a flashy winger who loves to take on defenders and take risks, or a more conservative fullback who’s defensively solid and rarely pushes up. Different play styles would add a lot of depth. • Different Career Paths: I’d love to see more variation in football career stories — like starting out as a wonderkid at a decent club with early fame, or being the son of a football legend, starting from a big-name academy. It would make the journey feel more personal and unique each time. • Expanded Tournaments: Including more major international competitions like AFCON, CONCACAF, and especially World Cup qualifiers would really help expand the global feel of the game. • Media and Fan Interaction: Having a feature where media or fans react to your performances would add immersion. Seeing how your form impacts your public perception could be super motivating or dramatic. • Rivalries: Introduce a system for rivalries — whether it’s a personal rivalry with another player or a tense title race with a specific team. It would raise the stakes and make key matches even more intense. Other than that, the game is genuinely great — just needs some polish in terms of bug fixes and visuals. Can’t wait to see how it develops!
